question: Which deities are to be installed on the spire and on the crest?
premises: The spire is specified as a location
Īśvara, the god, is associated with the spire
The lord of gods is associated with the crest
inference: Īśvara should be installed on the spire and the lord of gods on the crest.
plain_english: On the spire one should install the god Īśvara, and on the crest the lord of the gods.
